summary: Sales Reports Feature Testing - All tests passed. Backend (13/13) and Frontend UI testing complete. POS and Partner sales detail reports working correctly with proper margin calculations, quantity conversions, and CSV export.

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement recommended (carried over from previous iteration)

Backend: POS row has all required fields (date, product_name, quantity, cost_price, sell_price, total_sell, total_cost, margin) - PASS
Backend: POS total_margin calculation (total_sales - total_cost) is correct - PASS
Backend: POS empty date range returns empty rows and zero totals - PASS
Backend: GET /api/reports/partner-sales-detail returns 200 - PASS
Backend: Partner report response has correct structure - PASS

Backend: Partner total_margin calculation is correct - PASS
Backend: Partner quantity_satuan conversion for dus warehouse orders works correctly - PASS
Backend: Partner empty date range returns empty rows - PASS

Backend: Partner sales endpoint requires admin auth - PASS
Frontend: Tab switching between 'Penjualan POS' and 'Penjualan Kios Mitra' works - PASS
Frontend: Date range filter (Dari Tanggal / Sampai Tanggal) works - PASS
Frontend: Summary cards show Total Penjualan, Total HPP, Total Margin, Margin % - PASS

Frontend: Partner table shows all columns: Tanggal, Produk, Kios Mitra, Qty (satuan), HPP/Unit, Jual/Unit, Total Jual, Total HPP, Margin - PASS

seed_data_creation: Used existing transaction/order data from 2026-02-28 and 2026-03-02
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sales Reports feature is fully functional: 1) Navigate to 'Laporan' in sidebar. 2) Two tabs: 'Penjualan POS' (POS sales) and 'Penjualan Kios Mitra' (partner sales). 3) Date range filter with 'Dari Tanggal' and 'Sampai Tanggal'. 4) Generate Laporan button fetches data from respective API endpoints. 5) Summary cards show Total Penjualan, Total HPP, Total Margin, and Margin %. 6) POS table columns: Tanggal, Produk, Qty, HPP/Unit, Jual/Unit, Total Jual, Total HPP, Margin. 7) Partner table columns: Tanggal, Produk, Kios Mitra, Qty (satuan), HPP/Unit, Jual/Unit, Total Jual, Total HPP, Margin. 8) Partner qty displays satuan count with original dus in parentheses. 9) Both tables have TOTAL footer row. 10) Export CSV button downloads data as CSV file. Note: Some products have cost_price=0 (older data without cost tracking), so margin equals total_sell in those cases.
